questions.q: How did reading help Haig, according to the summary?
a: Alienated characters made him feel less alone
It let him escape from his family
It gave him a step-by-step cure
It distracted him from his work
questions.why: Lesson 1 says finding characters who felt alienated helped him see he was not alone.

questions.q: Which two leaders does the summary name as having depression?
questions.why: Lesson 2 mentions both leaders as examples of successful people who struggled silently.

questions.q: What benefit of mental illness does the summary mention?
a: Greater empathy and sensitivity to danger
questions.why: Lesson 2 says depression can deepen empathy and perception, as it may have for Lincoln and Churchill.

questions.q: What does the summary say about recovery from mental illness?
a: It is possible but does not follow a straight line
It happens quickly with the right pill
It requires avoiding all social contact
It ends once the symptoms disappear
questions.why: Lesson 3 says the healing process is not linear and Haig still lives with his illness.

questions.q: Which habit does Haig use to quiet his racing thoughts?
questions.why: Lesson 3 lists yoga and meditation among the tools that reduce the intensity of his thoughts.
